Name: The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter [Demo]
Author: Elaho
TagLine: The letter that's needed for the Grampleton Maker's Market to arrive in Pelican Town. (Demo version only)  **Shop compatibility coming soon! See mod description for details**
Description:
Welcome to The Grampleton Maker's Market!

*MAY 1, 2024:

While the Maker's Market Letter and Paisley's Bridal Boutique are now compatible with Stardew 1.6, all remaining Market Shops [Joseph's Seed Shop and Louvier Fromagerie] are NOT yet compatible with the latest 1.6 update.

But!! The next shop update [Joseph's Seed Shop] is expected to be launched in Summer 2024. I'll be updating pages on all mods connected to The Grampleton Maker's Market, including the Changelogs and Description [Warning: Spoilers] as the transition takes place. In the meantime, follow my Tumblr﻿ for more details and sneak peeks for what's to come. 

Thank you all for your patience and continued support  :)

-Elaho

This mod is part of a larger mod-in-progress called “The Grampleton Maker’s Market”. It includes the letter players MUST receive for the market stalls to appear in the town square. This mod is MANDATORY for any Grampleton Maker's Market vendors/stalls to appear. Market stall mods are separate from this "letter" mod. Current market stalls include:

- Paisley's Bridal Boutique (GMM)
- Joseph's Seed Shop (GMM)
- Louvier Fromagerie (GMM)

Each of these vendor mods can be played independently of each other, but all MUST have this letter mod installed to work/appear. 

-- Please note that this version of "The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter (GMM)" is a demo version of the upcoming GMM mod expansion and only features a portion of what will be included in the main mod. --


How to Receive the Maker's Market Letter: (Light Spoilers)

Players must have upgraded their farmhouse to include a kitchen to have the Maker's Market letter appear in the mailbox. After Robin has upgraded your house, you will receive a letter from Lewis explaining the Maker’s Market. You MUST have read this letter for any (separately downloaded) stalls to appear.
After the letter has been read, vendors will set up their shops every 6th, 7th, 20th, and 21st of each month (except winter) in the Town Square. All shops will be open from 9 AM to 6 PM regardless of the weather.

Mod Requirements and Compatibility:

The following mods must be installed for this mod to work properly:
-- SMAPI
-- Mail Framework Mod

Donations

The Grampleton Maker's Market is a free expansion pack for Stardew Valley and features a variety of new content to enhance your playthrough experience. With regular content updates, bug fixes, and transparent communication with the community, developing the Market to its full potential and adding additional shops, characters, and content takes a lot of time.

Please consider donating to me through Patreon.

If you see this mod on any other websites than the ones listed, it has been uploaded by someone else without my permission. Please only upload this Mod from Nexus, Curseforge, or ModDrop :) Thank you!
